  - describes Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII as an action RPG from Square Enix for the PlayStation Portable, a prequel to Final Fantasy VII and the fourth entry of the Compilation of Final Fantasy VII, played as Zack Fair, a Shinra soldier, with fast turns that feel like real-time combat

## Decisions
